say:2:1530130401:0.text: Because no Wildborn picks flowers like I do! My flowers are prettier than any you'll find in the forest!
say:2:1530130401:0.source_cn: 因为我是雅库伯尔最会采花的人！我的花比平时丛林里能见到...

say:3:1530130402:0.text: If you want to court a girl, bring her one of my bouquets. You won't go wrong!
say:3:1530130402:0.source_cn: 要是想向心爱的姑娘求偶，拿上我的花，肯定没错！

say:4:1530130403:0.text: ... Doesn't look all that special to me. Just common wildflowers.
say:4:1530130403:0.source_cn: ……根本看不出有什么特别的啊，不过是一束随处可见的花。

say:5:1530130404:0.text: I'll pick my own flowers—it'll mean more that way!
say:5:1530130404:0.source_cn: 我还是自己去采一束好了，至少也能显得我很有诚意！
